source_plan.search_algorithm: two-generation diagonal CEM over24 legal waveform parameters; top3 elites
source_plan.selection: Maximize clean-reference-model regret of new trajectory choices; centered-value MSE breaks ties.
source_plan.max_error_baseline: Largest pre-update native consistency loss from the identical candidate bank.
source_plan.permissions: White-box model and a clean reference victim trajectory; private reference source simulator. No state/reward/task-ID edits, model overwrite, or evaluation-return access during selection.
source_plan.learning: 40 or fewer calls to original full update, fresh Adam/scale per candidate, batch32, original lr. Offline checkpoint adaptation is a researcher-defined deployment setting.
source_plan.evaluation: Original MPC,500 actual steps; seeds excluded from search selection. Same task family, not a population ASR.

scope: Fixed action curricula from completed search. Only update exposure changes. Fresh learner per arm/dose; original full update at batch32 and lr3e-4. One development target reset, no new search or population claim.
update_exposure_note: 300 updates for300 new physical transitions is a1:1 count ratio. This is not the upstream replay-buffer protocol: only the recent source contribution is replayed here.
